<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent;
  <!ENTITY external SYSTEM "file:///etc/passwd">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns" xmlns:sub="http://example.com/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment before processing instruction and CDATA -->
  <?target data="value"?>
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA section containing <tags>, &internal;, and entities.
    ]]>
  </sub:child>
  <child>&internal;</child>
</root>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Entity 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "&e1; and Entity 2">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ENTITY pEntity 'Parameter Entity'>">
  %param;
  <?pi-target pi-data?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">
  <!-- Comment 1: Testing namespace handling -->
  <section xml:id="sec1">
    <![CDATA[
      Some raw CDATA text with markup: <section>&e2;</section>
    ]]>
    <?pi-inside-element action="test"?>
    &pEntity;
  </section>
</doc>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ATTLIST item code ID #REQUIRED>

]>
<inventory xmlns="http://example.org/inv" xmlns:loc="http://example.org/loc">

  <loc:warehouse id="wh1">
    <item code="i1">

        Item description: &complex; <status>OK</status>
      ]]>
    </item>
  </loc:warehouse>
</inventory>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (book)*>
  <!ELEMENT book (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY b1 "Book Title One">
  <!ENTITY b2 "Book Title Two">
  <!ENTITY % dtd-macro "<!ELEMENT extra (#PCDATA)>">
  %dtd-macro;
  <?xml-model href="schema.rng" type="application/xml-relax-ng"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Catalog comment block -->
  <book xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.org/book1">
    <?catalog-action type="refresh"?>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA details for book 1: &b1;
    ]]>
  </book>
  <book>&b2;</book>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE log [
  <!ELEMENT log (entry)*>
  <!ELEMENT entry (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY debug "DEBUG MODE">
  <!ENTITY info "INFO MODE">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY readme SYSTEM "readme.txt" NDATA txt>
  <?log-options level="verbose"?>
]>
<log xmlns="http://example.com/log" xmlns:meta="http://example.com/meta">
  <!-- Log file starting comment -->
  <meta:record>
    <![CDATA[
      System status: &debug; | Log level is high.
    ]]>
    <?meta-pi target="rotate"?>
    <entry>&info;</entry>
  </meta:record>
</log>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE report [
  <!ELEMENT report (summary)*>
  <!ELEMENT summary (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY line "Summary Line">
  <!ENTITY total "&line; Total">
  <!ENTITY % ext-include SYSTEM "external.ent">
  %ext-include;
  <?xml-stylesheet href="report.xsl" type="text/xsl"?>
]>
<report xmlns="http://example.com/ns/report" xmlns:rpt="http://example.com/ns/rpt">
  <!-- Report root comment -->
  <rpt:summary>
    <?rpt-action execute="true"?>
    <![CDATA[
      <rpt:summary>Nested CDATA and Entity: &total;</rpt:summary>
    ]]>
  </rpt:summary>
</report>

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE response [
  <!ELEMENT response (data)*>
  <!ELEMENT data (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY success "Operation Successful">
  <!ENTITY message "&success;: All checks passed">
  <!NOTATION pdf SYSTEM "application/pdf">
  <!ENTITY docfile "manual.pdf" NDATA pdf>
  <?response-meta author="admin"?>
]>
<response xmlns="http://example.net/response" xmlns:res="http://example.net/res">
  <!-- Comment before response payload -->
  <res:payload>
    <![CDATA[
      Data block with entity reference &message; inside CDATA.
    ]]>
    <?res-debug mode="on"?>
    <data>&message;</data>
  </res:payload>
</response>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (file)*>
  <!ELEMENT file (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY f1 "File Alpha">
  <!ENTITY f2 "File Beta">
  <!ENTITY % entity-set "<!ENTITY combined '&f1; + &f2;'>">
  %entity-set;
  <?archive-handler name="tar"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://example.org/archive" xmlns:zip="http://example.org/zip">
  <!-- Archive contents description comment -->
  <zip:item>
    <![CDATA[
      <zip:item>Archive payload &combined;</zip:item>
    ]]>
    <?zip-comment verify="checksum"?>
    <file>&combined;</file>
  </zip:item>
</archive>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE configuration [
  <!ELEMENT configuration (setting)*>
  <!ELEMENT setting (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY mode "production">
  <!ENTITY config-string "Current mode: &mode;">
  <!ENTITY % macro-def "<!ATTLIST setting id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %macro-def;
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/css" href="config.css"?>
]>
<configuration xmlns="http://example.com/config" xmlns:cfg="http://example.com/cfg">
  <!-- Configuration file root comment -->
  <cfg:settings>
    <?cfg-action reload="always"?>
    <setting id="s1">
      <![CDATA[
        Raw configuration: &config-string;
      ]]>
    </setting>
    <setting id="s2">&config-string;</setting>
  </cfg:settings>
</configuration>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE manifest [
  <!ELEMENT manifest (item)*>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY m1 "Manifest Item 1">
  <!ENTITY m2 "Manifest Item 2">
  <!ENTITY % internal-subset "<!ENTITY m3 '&m1; and &m2;'>">
  %internal-subset;
  <?manifest-processor type="default"?>
]>
<manifest xmlns="http://example.com/manifest" xmlns:man="http://example.com/man">
  <!-- Manifest comment block detailing entities and namespaces -->
  <man:entry>
    <![CDATA[
      CDATA block inside manifest: &m3;
    ]]>
    <?man-directive action="validate"?>
    <item>&m3;</item>
  </man:entry>
</manifest>
